# Tailwind CSS v4.3.3's theme, vendored as a reference palette.
#
# source:   https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss
# commit:   c2b24dd15fed1c59dd521bd86082f520c9f5ad0d (the v4.3.3 tag)
# package:  tailwindcss 4.3.3, https://registry.npmjs.org/tailwindcss/-/tailwindcss-4.3.3.tgz,
#           sha1 c006861611c213c1877893ab5b23daa16be2bb55 as the registry lists it
# fetched:  2026-10-11
# license:  MIT, Copyright (c) Tailwind Labs, Inc.; LICENSE beside this file is
#           the upstream file verbatim, which the licence asks every copy to carry
# checked:  every file taken is listed in SHA256SUMS with the sha256 of its upstream
#           bytes; `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` run from this directory verifies them
#
# Taken, at its upstream name: theme.css, whose `--color-<palette>-<step>` lines
# are the palette in oklch(), and the licence. The palette oracle
# (scripts/palette-oracle.lean) reads the colour lines through the engine's own
# oklch() reader; the theme's other tokens are not read.
#
# Left: the compiler (dist), the preflight and utility layers, index.css,
# package.json and the README.
